hints.title: Modulo Equivalence Partitioning
hints.text: Numbers with different remainders modulo k can never differ by k, so each residue class modulo k is completely independent.

hints.title: Arithmetic Progression Chains
hints.text: Within each remainder group, sort unique values. Adjacent elements differing by exactly k form contiguous dependency chains.

hints.title: Fibonacci Subproblem
hints.text: For a chain of length L where no two adjacent items can be selected simultaneously, the valid subset count follows the Fibonacci sequence.

hints.title: Chain Fibonacci Product Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting each modulo partition takes O(n log n); chain dynamic programming takes O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all 2^n subsets is infeasible for n up to 50.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decomposes into independent modulo chains and uses Fibonacci count multiplication.
